description: Suppliers listed on Suppliers Net, by what they sell and where. Returns name, categories, state, a profile link, and a status: verified (claimed and ABN matched), checked, claimed, or listed (from public records). No phone numbers or email addresses are returned; the profile page says how to contact a supplier.

category.description: What they sell, e.g. 'seafood', 'lamb', 'produce'. Empty for any.

state.description: State code or name: NSW, VIC, QLD, SA, WA, TAS, NT, ACT. Empty for national.

name: find_suppliers
title: Find Australian food suppliers
